text: すきな　ほうを　えらんで　くれい！

patterns.name: 〜てくれ
patterns.explanation: くれ after a て-form verb is a plain, blunt way to ask someone to do something. The extra い is an old-man flourish. えらんで　くれい = 'go ahead and choose'.

patterns.name: 〜ほう
patterns.explanation: ほう means 'the one' out of two choices. すきな　ほう = 'the one you like'.
